claims.text: Mastra describes itself on its Web Summit page as an open source TypeScript framework and enterprise platform for building, iterating and managing production-grade agents.
claims.quote: for building, iterating, and managing production-grade agents

claims.text: Web Summit's page lists Mastra from United States.

Keewano says it is building the first database for AI agents; KeewanoDB keeps every event across users, devices and agents as an ordered history so agents can reason over massive volumes of event data.
claims.quote: enabling AI agents to reason directly over massive volumes of event data

claims.text: Web Summit's page lists Keewano from Israel.
Acrab says it builds computing infrastructure for agentic AI (chips, edge models, software and orchestration) to run intelligent agents on devices.
claims.quote: to run intelligent agents on devices

claims.text: Web Summit's page lists Acrab AI from Singapore.
Humanos says it is building the risk and reputation network for AI agents: each agent gets a persistent identity and a Risk Passport reflecting its behaviour, permissions and track record.
claims.quote: building the risk and reputation network for AI agents

claims.text: Web Summit's page lists Humanos from United States.
Polygraf AI says its AI Behavioral Control Plane delivers real-time visibility, governance and inline enforcement across human and agentic AI interactions.
claims.quote: inline enforcement across human and agentic AI interactions

claims.text: Web Summit's page lists Polygraf AI from United States.
GetVocal says its platform orchestrates an AI fleet across every channel for enterprise contact centres.
claims.quote: orchestrates an AI fleet across every channel

claims.text: Web Summit's page lists GetVocal AI from France.
Beyond Presence says it makes real-time AI avatars for enterprise conversations; its description does not mention agents.
claims.quote: Real-time AI avatars for enterprise conversations

claims.text: Web Summit's page lists Beyond Presence from Germany.
Cnext says it builds agentic AI solutions for European businesses on its own Kairos platform.
claims.quote: We build agentic AI solutions for European businesses

claims.text: Web Summit's page lists Cnext from Belgium.
